title: Aquarium
content: I have visited an aquarium many time it always starts at a dusty ranch , the land around this ranch is in a flat valley almost like in cars . Hills off in the distance with a large highway rolling threw it . I always drive down a straight 2 lane road and Trum off on to the highway then i appear outside this large pull up are outside the aquarium. Picture a airport like building that has this huge over hanging roof . I get out of the car and look where we came from , I can still see the ranch off in the distance then I turn to the side walk infront of me is this large dark grey concrete wall and a escalators taking us down to the entrance of the aquarium . It's a calm blue with a modle of a whale shark hanging from the ceiling , (sometimes it's a whale ) I don't remember much wandering around sometimes I'm with my grandparents , sometimes I'm alone . when I'm done my tour of this aquarium i always exit into a mall where I end up looking for who i was with . If I leave the aquarium alone I go shopping for gifts or find my way to a very fancy hotel that is on the water . Being alone is always the most fun . My senses is this dream world is I know that there is a outdoor market close by , rolling green hills , and a bustling large city with lots of tall skyscrapers . All of these places are very large but very close together all at the same time . I also visit a cruise ship but that for another post ..Maybe (I've never been on a cruise ship in real life )
